title: Advanced SELECT [BETWEEN]
description:
## BETWEEN
Instead of writing:
```sql
SELECT * FROM servers WHERE uptime >= 50 AND uptime <= 99;
```
You can write:
```sql
SELECT * FROM servers WHERE uptime BETWEEN 50 AND 99;
```
Same result, cleaner syntax. BETWEEN is inclusive on both ends.


---
## Assignment:
BWS needs to find servers with moderate uptime. Select all servers where uptime is between 40 and 96.
